paramSemantics.band: visual placement/readability band for full-world params; distinct from declared compositionOwnership.lane
paramSemantics.position: world-composition placement only; accepted module source identity is unchanged
paramSemantics.scale: world-composition readability scale only; not a source/module replacement
paramSemantics.rotation: world-composition orientation only; camera remains unchanged

owns: elapsedSeconds-derived transforms
capture-mode freeze or fixed-time behavior
slow low-intensity cadence
unresolved-motion that clarifies collision, revision, and spread

avoid: fast flames, emergency spectacle, or literal response animation
deltaSeconds instability except clamped true integration
changing creative ownership of forms, marks, or news metaphor
